scope: Automatic startup validation in a normally launched Cocoa editor, its isolated native resource consumers, receipt cache and rejection behavior.
diagnosis: The old harness exits after 600 frames even when the asynchronous child has not reached its terminal receipt. The first macOS job observed two banners and exit zero without either receipt or marker. The precise reason the child was slow in that job was not captured. Delaying only the real cold child reproduces exactly that outcome. Waiting for the outcome and its cache write before requesting native closure passes under the same delay.
product_impact: The repair changes only the acceptance harness. The retained signed executable, two installed resources, production coordinator and project acceptance assertions are unchanged.

The first comparison workflow omitted the independent partial-child GDScript in its sparse checkout, so the full old suite then failed with FileNotFoundError. The fixed suite included the fixture and passed. The scheduled comparison checks out both scripts.

known_diagnostics.observed: When the headless editor exits after printing the two native package digests and entry marker, it logs RID/ObjectDB cleanup diagnostics before the parent prints passed. The unscheduled old harness contains them too. The warm cached parent never launches that child. These diagnostics did not prevent the observed content-addressed receipts or change either negative case.
